obj.cari_jalan: Cari jalan pulang sebelum malam larut

makanan.1: Di atas batu teras ada mangkuk nasi. Ditutup daun pisang.
makanan.2: Raka masak tadi malam. Dia menyisakan porsi untukku.
makanan.3: Aku belum sempat bilang terima kasih. Kalau malam ini berlalu, aku akan bilang.

jejak.1: Tanah di tepi hutan masih basah. Jejak kaki baru tercetak di sini.
jejak.2: Ukurannya kecil. Arahnya dari pondok Joy, bukan ke jalan desa.
jejak.3: Aku bisa mengikuti jejak ini beberapa langkah. Atau membiarkannya.

a.1: Jejak berhenti di akar pohon besar. Tidak ada tanda kembali.
a.2: Di belakangku ada suara ranting patah. Lalu sunyi lagi.

b.1: Aku buang jejak itu dari kepalaku. Malam ini bukan waktunya mencari.

napas.1: Udara mendadak dingin. Napasku jadi kabut putih.
napas.2: Biasanya begini kalau ada yang berdiri dekat. Tanpa suara, tanpa langkah.
napas.3: Aku mempercepat langkah. Mataku tetap di jalan.

ranting.1: Ranting patah di belakangku. Aku tidak menoleh.
ranting.2: Kalau aku menoleh sekarang, aku akan berhenti. Dan aku tidak boleh berhenti.

bayangan.1: Antara batang pohon ada sosok berdiri. Rambutnya jatuh sampai bahu.
bayangan.2: Sosok itu tidak bergerak. Hanya menatap, seperti menunggu aku sadar.
bayangan.3: Aku bisa berteriak, atau mundur. Dua-duanya membuat aku berhenti sebentar.
bayangan.cA: Berteriak. Biar dia tahu aku melihat.

a.1: Aku berteriak. Suaraku sendiri yang kembali dari pepohonan.
a.2: Sosok itu tetap di tempat. Malah dinginnya yang makin dekat.

b.1: Aku mundur satu langkah. Kakiku menyentuh semak, lalu berlari.
b.2: Aku tidak mendengar langkah dari belakang. Hanya napasku sendiri.

lari.1: Kakiku hampir menyerah. Napas terasa sesak dan dingin.
lari.2: Sosok itu makin dekat. Aku bisa merasakan dinginnya tanpa menoleh.
lari.3: Tinggal beberapa langkah lagi ke pinggir jalan.

lari.1: Aku terus berlari. Mataku hanya pada tanah di depanku.
lari.2: Dingin di belakangku perlahan menjauh. Sampai aku tidak mendengar apa-apa lagi.

berhenti.1: Aku berhenti. Kakiku berhenti sebelum kepala sempat protes.
berhenti.2: Aku menoleh. Sosok itu berdiri lima langkah dariku, menatap saja.
berhenti.3: Tidak ada teriakan. Tidak ada marah. Hanya tatapan yang lama sekali.

pulang.1: Aku sampai di pinggir jalan desa. Lampu rumahku masih menyala.
pulang.2: Tanganku meraba saku. Kalung yang selama ini kubawa tidak ada lagi.
pulang.3: Aku berhenti sebentar. Lalu melanjutkan langkah. Biar saja malam ini.

obj.cari_jalan: Find your way home before the night gets later
obj.lari: Do not stop. Do not look back.

makanan.1: On the terrace stone there is a bowl of rice. Covered with a banana leaf.
makanan.2: Raka cooked last night. He left a portion for me.
makanan.3: I have not had the chance to say thank you. If tonight passes, I will say it.

jejak.1: The soil at the forest edge is still wet. Fresh footprints are printed here.
jejak.2: They are small. They lead from Joy's hut, not toward the village road.
jejak.3: I can follow these prints for a few steps. Or leave them alone.
jejak.cB: Leave them. I have to get home.

a.1: The prints stop at the roots of a big tree. There is no sign of a way back.
a.2: Behind me a branch snaps. Then silence again.

b.1: I push the prints out of my head. Tonight is not the time to look.
b.2: My steps toward home grow faster.

napas.1: The air suddenly turns cold. My breath turns to white fog.
napas.2: This usually happens when someone stands close. Without a sound, without footsteps.
napas.3: I quicken my pace. My eyes stay on the road.

ranting.1: A branch snaps behind me. I do not look back.
ranting.2: If I look back now, I will stop. And I must not stop.

bayangan.1: Between the tree trunks a figure stands. Her hair falls to the shoulders.
bayangan.2: The figure does not move. It only watches, as if waiting for me to realize.
bayangan.3: I can scream, or step back. Either one makes me stop for a moment.
bayangan.cA: Scream. Let it know I see it.

a.1: I scream. Only my own voice comes back from the trees.
a.2: The figure stays where it is. The cold is what moves closer.

b.1: I step back once. My foot touches the bushes, then I run.
b.2: I hear no footsteps behind me. Only my own breath.

lari.1: My legs are about to give up. My breath feels tight and cold.
lari.2: The figure is closer. I can feel its cold without looking back.
lari.3: Only a few steps left to the edge of the road.
lari.cA: Keep running. Do not look back.

lari.1: I keep running. My eyes stay on the ground in front of me.
lari.2: The cold behind me slowly fades. Until I hear nothing anymore.

berhenti.1: I stop. My feet stop before my head can protest.
berhenti.2: I turn around. The figure stands five steps from me, simply staring.
berhenti.3: No scream. No anger. Only a gaze that lasts a long time.
berhenti.4: Then the cold lets me go.

pulang.1: I reach the edge of the village road. The light in my house is still on.
pulang.2: My hand pats my pocket. The necklace I always carried is gone.
pulang.3: I stop for a moment. Then I keep walking. Let tonight be.
